title: A Privacy Budgeting Framework for Online Experimentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Firms perform online experiments with multi-armed bandits to personalize what consumers are shown while balancing exploration and exploitation. However, third-parties can infer consumers' underlying segments from observing which banners, ads, or recommendations consumers receive. To control this inference, we propose a privacy risk budget that firms can set ex ante to bound such third party belief updating using differential privacy. To spend this privacy risk budget, we propose two strategies: a constant privacy risk strategy and a dynamic privacy risk strategy that spend privacy risk differently across visitor. We study how privacy risk budgets affect experimentation performance in two applications--website design and a recommendation system--under these strategies. translated_title: 在线实验的隐私预算框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19944v1 公告类型：新 摘要：企业使用多臂老虎机进行在线实验，以个性化展示给消费者的内容，同时平衡探索与利用。然而，第三方可以通过观察消费者收到的横幅、广告或推荐来推断其潜在细分群体。为控制这种推断，我们提出了一种隐私风险预算，企业可以事先设定该预算，利用差分隐私来限制第三方信念更新。为花费这一隐私风险预算，我们提出了两种策略：恒定隐私风险策略和动态隐私风险策略，它们在访客之间以不同方式分配隐私风险。我们研究了在两种应用场景（网站设计和推荐系统）中，这些策略下隐私风险预算如何影响实验性能。对于两种策略，我们分析性地找到了能最优平衡探索与利用的隐私风险预算。然后，我们将实验级隐私风险的概念进一步扩展。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于差分隐私的隐私预算框架，通过两种策略（恒定和动态）分配隐私风险，以在线实验中平衡探索与利用，并优化实验性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differential privacy-based budget framework with constant and dynamic strategies to allocate privacy risk, balancing exploration and exploitation in online experiments and optimizing performance.
